beats.vo: Most guys put this off because it feels awkward to bring up. So it ends up happening at the worst possible moment, with no plan, while you're already nervous.
beats.visual_intent: Unopened envelope on a table, dim light.

beats.vo: Asking ahead doesn't kill anything. It's a normal question between adults, and it tells her you're thinking about her, not just about the night.
beats.visual_intent: Doorway with warm light spilling into a dark room, no people.

beats.vo: And if neither of you has any, you find out with time to fix it.
beats.visual_intent: Convenience store exterior at night, lit up, no people.

beats.vo: Just ask ahead: "Do you have condoms, or should I bring some?"
beats.visual_intent: Hand typing on a phone, warm low light, no face, screen not readable.

beats.vo: It takes ten seconds over text. Then that's one less thing to fumble with when you're already nervous.
